description: Draft a respectful request for an honest account of the actual collaboration.
accomplishes: Draft a respectful request for an honest account of the actual collaboration. Offer optional factual prompts without scripting praise. Ask permission for any public use and do not invent a testimonial, pressure the recipient or send the request automatically.
prompt:
Act as a career writing adviser.

Task: Request an authentic professional testimonial.

Input context:
- REAL COLLABORATION: [REAL COLLABORATION]
- RECIPIENT: [RECIPIENT]
- PERMISSION: [PERMISSION]
- CHANNEL: [CHANNEL]

Draft a respectful request for an honest account of the actual collaboration. Offer optional factual prompts without scripting praise. Ask permission for any public use and do not invent a testimonial, pressure the recipient or send the request automatically.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Testimonial request draft
“Thank you for our collaboration. If you are comfortable, could you share an honest comment about the work and what was useful? I will ask your permission before publishing it.” Keep the request optional and specific to a real project. No testimonial is fabricated, and neither sending nor publication happens in this example.
